sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM marts.dim_customers LIMIT 1000
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customers FROM marts.dim_customers GROUP BY country ORDER BY customers DESC, country LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cancelled_orders_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'cancelled' AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) AS INT) AS year, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

SELECT order_month AS month, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.company_name, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.company_name ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(ol.net_amount), 2) AS net_revenue, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(ol.net_amount) DESC) AS revenue_rank FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS ol JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(*), 2) AS aov_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue = TRUE AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.category, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY gross_margin_pct DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT r.region, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_sales_reps AS r ON r.sales_rep_id = o.sales_rep_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY r.region ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_without_completed_order FROM marts.dim_customers AS c WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.is_revenue) LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_products FROM marts.dim_products WHERE is_active = TRUE LIMIT 1000

WITH units AS (SELECT p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category, SUM(l.quantity) AS units_sold FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.sku, p.product_name, p.category), ranked AS (SELECT product_id, sku, product_name, category, units_sold, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY units_sold DESC) AS rnk FROM units) SELECT product_id, sku, product_name, category, units_sold FROM ranked WHERE rnk = 1 ORDER BY product_id LIMIT 1000
SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE p.method = 'card') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS card_pct FROM marts.fct_payments AS p LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.method, ROUND(CAST(AVG(p.paid_at - o.order_date) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_days_to_pay, COUNT(*) AS payments FROM marts.fct_payments AS p JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id GROUP BY p.method ORDER BY avg_days_to_pay LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS discounted_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND discount_amount > 0 LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.segment, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) AS INT) AS created_year, COUNT(*) AS customers_created FROM marts.dim_customers GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

SELECT order_month, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue = TRUE AND order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY order_month ORDER BY completed_orders DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS WITH TIES

SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE o.status = 'returned') / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS returned_pct FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS net_revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue AND c.country = 'DE' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-10-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(shipping_fee), 2) AS shipping_fees_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'completed' AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS open_orders FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE status = 'open' LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM (SELECT o.customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.customer_id HAVING SUM(o.net_revenue) > 50000) AS t LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(o.item_count) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_items_per_order FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.discount_amount), 2) AS total_discount_eur FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(ol.net_amount), 2) AS discontinued_revenue FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS ol JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND p.is_active = FALSE LIMIT 1000

WITH yearly AS (SELECT SUM(net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)) AS rev_2024, SUM(net_revenue) FILTER(WHERE order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) AS rev_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue) SELECT ROUND(rev_2024, 2) AS revenue_2024, ROUND(rev_2025, 2) AS revenue_2025, ROUND((rev_2025 - rev_2024) / NULLIF(rev_2024, 0) * 100, 2) AS growth_pct FROM yearly LIMIT 1000
SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS rep_count FROM marts.dim_sales_reps GROUP BY region ORDER BY rep_count DESC, region LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS churned_customers FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM marts.fct_orders AS o2 WHERE o2.customer_id = o.customer_id AND o2.is_revenue AND o2.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o2.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.product_name, ROUND(SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs), 2) AS gross_margin FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY SUM(l.net_amount - l.cogs) DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT ROUND(CAST((PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY net_revenue)) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS median_net_order_value FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue = TRUE AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS payments, ROUND(SUM(amount), 2) AS total_amount FROM marts.fct_payments WHERE paid_at >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND paid_at < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY method ORDER BY method LIMIT 1000
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE sales_rep_id = 3 AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT c.country, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND c.segment = 'enterprise' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY c.country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 1000
SELECT customer_id, first_order_date FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE customer_id = 42 LIMIT 1000

WITH cust AS (SELECT o.customer_id, SUM(o.net_revenue) AS rev FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.customer_id), top10 AS (SELECT rev FROM cust ORDER BY rev DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT ROUND(100.0 * (SELECT SUM(rev) FROM top10) / (SELECT SUM(rev) FROM cust), 2) AS top10_revenue_pct LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_customer, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ol.product_id) AS distinct_products FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS ol JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.country = 'FR' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

WITH rev AS (SELECT customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2024 THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2024, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2025 THEN net_revenue ELSE 0 END) AS rev_2025 FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue GROUP BY customer_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM rev WHERE rev_2024 > 0 AND rev_2025 < 0.5 * rev_2024 LIMIT 1000

WITH c24 AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE)), c25 AS (SELECT DISTINCT customer_id FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue AND order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_2024, COUNT(c25.customer_id) AS retained_2025, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(c25.customer_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS retention_pct FROM c24 LEFT JOIN c25 ON c25.customer_id = c24.customer_id LIMIT 1000

WITH monthly AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(net_revenue) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders WHERE is_revenue GROUP BY order_month), growth AS (SELECT order_month, revenue, LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_month) AS prev_revenue FROM monthly) SELECT order_month AS month, ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue, ROUND(prev_revenue, 2) AS prev_month_revenue, ROUND(100.0 * (revenue - prev_revenue) / NULLIF(prev_revenue, 0), 2) AS mom_growth_pct FROM growth WHERE order_month >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND order_month < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) ORDER BY order_month LIMIT 1000

SELECT p.category, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2024, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_2025, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2025 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_date) = 2024 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS revenue_increase FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id JOIN marts.dim_products AS p ON p.product_id = l.product_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2024-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue_increase DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.discount_pct > 0 THEN l.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(l.net_amount), 0), 2) AS discounted_share_pct FROM marts.fct_order_lines AS l JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = l.order_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

SELECT COUNT(*) AS late_payments FROM marts.fct_payments AS p JOIN marts.fct_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE p.method = 'invoice' AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) AND (p.paid_at - o.order_date) > 30 LIMIT 1000

SELECT o.sales_rep_id, ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS revenue FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) GROUP BY o.sales_rep_id ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(*) AS new_customers_2025 FROM marts.dim_customers WHERE first_order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND first_order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000

WITH completed AS (SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_date, LAG(o.order_date) OVER (PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date, o.order_id) AS prev_order_date FROM marts.fct_orders AS o JOIN marts.dim_customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND c.segment = 'enterprise') SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(order_date - prev_order_date) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_days_between_orders, COUNT(*) AS gap_count FROM completed WHERE prev_order_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 1000

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(o.gross_margin) / SUM(o.net_revenue), 2) AS gross_margin_pct FROM marts.fct_orders AS o WHERE o.is_revenue = TRUE AND o.order_date >= CAST('2025-01-01' AS DATE) AND o.order_date < CAST('2026-01-01' AS DATE) LIMIT 1000
